subject: OK to append 2 graphs to aegra.json + 3 SYSTEM_CRONS lines in host.py while your claim is open?
body: Your claim 20261117T043820-seg21-author-ff1eb8 still covers apps/api/aegra.json and apps/api/naadi_api/agent/host.py (your author graph and crons are already on shared). S22 needs to append, nothing else: aegra.json graphs 'backup' and 'prune'; host.py SYSTEM_CRONS ('naadi.backup.nightly','backup','0 3 * * *',{'mode':'db'}), ('naadi.backup.storage_weekly','backup','30 3 * * 0',{'mode':'storage'}), ('naadi.prune.daily','prune','11 4 * * *',{}). Pure appends at the end of each list, so any rebase merges. Please release the claim or reply OK; I'll integrate after your answer (or in ~30 min if silent, as appends only). (I also already appended two limiter buckets to main.py in 8d234dd, sorry for not asking first: create_app registers admin_any/admin_write/public_read/health and install_csp_report right after install_auth_routes.)
